panels.description: Requests served by each service over the selected time range.
panels.title: Traffic share by service

panels.description: Request rate in each latency bucket over time; darker cells mean more requests.
panels.title: Request latency distribution

panels.description: Every sampled p95 latency in the time range, counted into 20 equal bands.
panels.title: How often p95 latency lands in each band

panels.description: Server span latency at the 50th to 99th percentile for each service.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.1 AS percentile, t.2 / 1e6 AS frontend, t.3 / 1e6 AS checkout, t.4 / 1e6 AS payments FROM ( SELECT arrayJoin(arrayZip([50, 75, 90, 95, 99], quantilesIf(0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99)(Duration, ServiceName = 'frontend'), quantilesIf(0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99)(Duration, ServiceName = 'checkout'), quantilesIf(0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99)(Duration, ServiceName = 'payments'))) AS t FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' ) ORDER BY percentile

panels.title: Latency by percentile and service

panels.description: One point per trace: how long the payment took against how long the whole checkout took.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sumIf(Duration, SpanName = 'authorize_card') / 1e6 AS authorize_ms, sumIf(Duration, SpanName = 'POST /api/checkout') / 1e6 AS checkout_ms FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanName IN ('authorize_card', 'POST /api/checkout') GROUP BY TraceId HAVING authorize_ms > 0 AND checkout_ms > 0 LIMIT 500

panels.title: Card authorization against checkout time

panels.description: First, highest, lowest and last POST /checkout latency in each 5 minute window, with the request count as volume.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, argMin(Duration, Timestamp) / 1e6 AS open, max(Duration) / 1e6 AS high, min(Duration) / 1e6 AS low, argMax(Duration, Timestamp) / 1e6 AS close, count() AS volume FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND SpanName = 'POST /checkout' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Checkout latency per 5 minutes

panels.description: Healthy below 1% server errors, degraded up to 5%, failing above.
panels.title: Service health over time

panels.description: Whether Prometheus could scrape each demo target, one cell per minute.
panels.title: Scrape target availability

panels.description: Firing and pending Prometheus alerts. HighErrorRate and SlowRequests fire after a fault is injected into checkout.
panels.title: Firing alerts

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, SeverityText AS severity, count() AS n FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, severity ORDER BY time
SELECT SpanName AS span, quantile(0.99)(Duration) / 1e6 AS p99_ms, count() AS n FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY span ORDER BY p99_ms DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Timestamp, Body FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SeverityText = 'ERROR' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Services with their request count and average latency; the ring shows the share of failed spans. Edges count calls between services.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ServiceName AS id, ServiceName AS title, count() AS mainstat, avg(Duration) / 1e6 AS secondarystat, 1 - countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / count() AS arc__success, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / count() AS arc__errors FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' GROUP BY ServiceName

SELECT concat(p.ServiceName, ' -> ', c.ServiceName) AS id, p.ServiceName AS source, c.ServiceName AS target, count() AS mainstat FROM otel_traces AS c INNER JOIN otel_traces AS p ON c.ParentSpanId = p.SpanId AND c.TraceId = p.TraceId WHERE $__timeFilter(c.Timestamp) AND $__timeFilter(p.Timestamp) AND p.ServiceName != c.ServiceName GROUP BY source, target LIMIT 200

panels.title: Service map

panels.description: The span waterfall of the slowest request that started in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT TraceId AS traceID, SpanId AS spanID, ParentSpanId AS parentSpanID, ServiceName AS serviceName, SpanName AS operationName, Timestamp AS startTime, Duration / 1000000 AS duration, StatusCode AS statusCode, SpanAttributes AS tags FROM otel_traces WHERE TraceId = (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ParentSpanId = '' ORDER BY Duration DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY startTime LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Slowest request in range

panels.description: Time spent in each service operation across the latest 300 requests; wider bars cost more.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE spans AS ( SELECT TraceId, SpanId, ParentSpanId, concat(ServiceName, ' ', SpanName) AS name, Duration / 1e6 AS ms FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ParentSpanId = '' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 300) ), tree AS ( SELECT TraceId, SpanId, ['all requests', name] AS path, ms FROM spans WHERE ParentSpanId = '' UNION ALL SELECT s.TraceId, s.SpanId, arrayPushBack(t.path, s.name), s.ms FROM spans AS s INNER JOIN tree AS t ON s.TraceId = t.TraceId AND s.ParentSpanId = t.SpanId ), paths AS ( SELECT path, sum(ms) AS value FROM tree GROUP BY path UNION ALL SELECT ['all requests'] AS root, sum(ms) AS root_ms FROM tree WHERE length(tree.path) = 2 ), children AS ( SELECT arrayPopBack(path) AS parent, sum(value) AS spent FROM paths GROUP BY parent ) SELECT length(p.path) - 1 AS level, round(p.value, 3) AS value, round(greatest(p.value - c.spent, 0), 3) AS self, p.path[-1] AS label FROM paths AS p LEFT JOIN children AS c ON p.path = c.parent ORDER BY p.path

panels.title: Where request time goes

panels.description: Each demo service is placed on an example region; the shop itself runs on one host. Marker size is request volume and color is the server error ratio.

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(ServiceName = 'frontend', 50.11, ServiceName = 'checkout', 53.35, 38.9) AS lat, multiIf(ServiceName = 'frontend', 8.68, ServiceName = 'checkout', -6.26, -77.04) AS lon, multiIf(ServiceName = 'frontend', 'eu-central', ServiceName = 'checkout', 'eu-west', 'us-east') AS region, ServiceName AS service, count() AS requests, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / count() AS error_ratio FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' GROUP BY ServiceName

panels.title: Requests by service region

panels.description: Server error ratio of each service in the request path, colored by health.
panels.title: Checkout flow health

options.content:
This dashboard is written in Grafana's dashboard format and imported into SlashObserve.

It carries one panel of every Grafana panel type SlashObserve supports, backed by the demo shop's Prometheus metrics and ClickHouse logs and traces.
